controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by HAT-P-26; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured color.
controls.notes: No image or color of HAT-P-26 b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the color of hat-p-26's light, as its color dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of HAT-P-26's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HAT-P-26 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

HAT-P-26 b's transmission spectrum: the fraction of starlight the planet blocks as it crosses its star, larger where its atmosphere absorbs. 23 measured bins from Stevenson et al. 2016 (Magellan II Landon Clay Telescope, LDSS-3C), as the NASA Exoplanet Archive lists them. Horizontal bars are wavelength bins; vertical bars are the published 1-sigma errors.

HAT-P-26 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (50) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 420779000, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.

physical.credit: Radius from Stassun et al. 2017 (2017AJ....153..136S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; mass from Stassun et al. 2017, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2017AJ....153..136S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; orbit from Stassun et al. 2017 (2017AJ....153..136S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive
